2023_060_jan_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly purchasing-card report for January 2023, carried on the Board of Education agenda of March 21, 2023, itemizes every PCARD charge and credit posted under the journal-entry description "JAN PCARD EXP," listing transaction date and merchant, budget unit, account code, transaction amount and credit. Postings run from late December 2022 through 1/25/2023 and cover general-fund, grant, special-education, community-program and student-activity budget units across every school and department, with page footers dated 3/16/2023 through page 28. The schedule closes with a subtotal of 243,538.96 in charges against 2,540.81 in credits and Total Expenses of 240,998.15.
